verified: The Ladybird project published its first alpha on 23 November 2026, installable on macOS and Linux without compiling it yourself; the project's own October newsletter reported that it passed Safari Technology Preview on the Web Platform Tests suite on 26 October, after gaining roughly 75,650 passes in five days (Ladybird).
unconfirmed: That the alpha is usable as a daily browser — the project itself warns that some sites will not work and that it will crash sometimes, and explicitly makes "no promises about security today." The 7x JetStream 3 WebAssembly speedup and the scale of coding-agent contributions are the project's own figures rather than independent measurements, and the smooth-rendering reports come from a handful of individual commenters and one blogger's testing, not a broad compatibility study.

verified: Ladybird 项目于 11 月 23 日发布了首个 alpha 版，macOS 和 Linux 用户无需自行编译即可安装，项目官方声明中承认部分网站无法使用、会崩溃，并且“今天对安全性不做任何承诺”。Ladybird 自己的 10 月通讯称，当月网页平台测试（WPT，约 225 万项子测试）通过数增加 75,650 项，并在 10 月 26 日超过 Safari Technology Preview；维基百科条目确认该项目以 BSD 2-Clause 许可开源，并于 2026 年 2 月开始把 JavaScript 解析器从 C++ 移植到 Rust。
unconfirmed: JetStream 3 的 WebAssembly 基准提升 7 倍、布局与 JIT 改进的实际体验收益，均为项目方自述，尚无独立复测；哪些具体模型被用于批量修复 WPT，官方未披露。早期用户“网站几乎全部正常渲染”属个人测试反馈，Datasette Lite 因 service worker 相关接口缺失而报错，说明兼容性仍有缺口。alpha 版的日常使用稳定性与安全性均未经验证。
